cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C1 pattern - Sodium Laureth Sulfate #2 buffered by Cocamidopropyl Betaine #4 (Sodium Xylenesulfonate #3 is a hydrotrope); TEA-Dodecylbenzenesulfonate #18 is a late emulsion-carrier anionic, not a reinforcing cleansing route; no reset intent.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one meaningful silicone/cationic deposition system - Dimethiconol #10, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride #11, Dimethicone #14 - with late Panthenol #19; no pearlizer/fatty route or humectant cluster, silicones after Parfum.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Two silicones plus guar approach the C2 'multiple systems' pattern.

weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: silicone (dimethiconol #10, dimethicone #14) plus cationic guar #11 is one meaningfully persistent deposition system, bounded by an effective SLES/betaine base and no rich 2-in-1 architecture (W1 analogue).
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: one route kind with effective reset. Low is the realistic neighbor because the silicones sit after Parfum.

focusPrimary.rationale: General: dominant positioning is hair loss / growth / density ('Anti-Haarverlust', 'Grow', 'dichteres Haar'), which is out of scope and cannot carry a focus. The remaining 'stärkt feines, schwaches Haar' / 'verringert Haarbruch' language has a nonspecific care-direction verdict (silicone + guar + late panthenol, no damage-care cluster). Piroctone Olamine #6 has no dandruff positioning, so not scalp_active (7.2).
focusPrimary.counterSignal: Breakage-reduction claim (repair) and an unpositioned dandruff active.
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Blind: SLES/betaine + silicone/guar + piroctone -> nonspecific care. Unblind: hair-loss positioning excluded; breakage claim over nonspecific formula -> general.

focusSecondary.rationale: Empty: no in-scope distinct positioning with an independent route.

usageRole.rationale: Regular: 'regelmäßig' is not a daily/frequent trigger; the problem led positioning is hair loss (out of scope), and the recognized dandruff active is not positioned for its problem, so no treatment trigger.
usageRole.counterSignal: Problem-led product containing a recognized active.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: No sensitive/itchy/dry-scalp positioning; Menthol #12 and prominent fragrance are counter-signals.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Complete INCI contains Piroctone Olamine #6 (formula only, §11).

projection.thicknessRationale: T1 W moderate, C moderate: fine acceptable, normal ideal, coarse acceptable. Ordinary, no T6. T4: W neighbor low raises fine and keeps normal ideal; C neighbor high raises coarse -> no flags. T2: 'feines Haar' ignored.
projection.scalpTargetRationale: S-HAIRLOSS: hair-loss/growth positioning (and 'Halt der Haarwurzeln an der Kopfhaut') was not evaluated and creates no target. S-DANDRUFF: supported but no E2 dandruff claim -> no target, informational note. -> ordinary. Positioning evidence is retailer-only.
projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1: moderate -> regular; I3: no neighbor.
projection.liveComparison: Not evaluated (live rows not in sealed packet).

uncertainties: §9 'treatment' = 'problem-led recognized active route': here the product is problem-led (hair loss, out of scope) and has a recognized active (piroctone) that serves a different, unpositioned problem. Resolved regular.
Focus when dominant claims are hair loss (out of scope): no §7 row; resolved general.
Identity: product name 'Grow Abundance' vs retailer copy 'Grow Abundant'; treated as the same product (no formula conflict in packet). Only retailer positioning available.
